purpose: Teach: カキコ/小中学校/新米/百姓/貧乏人/里山/駿/ぎょ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ネットの匿名カキコに気を付けろよ
lines.en: Riku, watch yourself with anonymous posts online, okay?
lines.style: Casual warning, half-joking but with real concern underneath. Quick tempo. Leans on 'watch yourself' like she's done this before. Protective older-friend energy.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、小中学校時代の同級生覚えてるよな、桜
lines.en: You remember the kids from elementary and middle school, right, Sakura?
lines.style: Slow, almost testing. Quiet curiosity — like he's asking something bigger than the words. Measured pace. Not defensive, just... careful.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、部活で新米だってよく言ってたな
lines.en: You used to say all the time that you were the newcomer at club activities.
lines.style: Dry, half-smile in the voice. Casual recall, slightly teasing. Light pace. The tone of someone remembering something small and fond.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で「百姓一揆」習ったろ、桜
lines.en: You studied peasant uprisings in history class, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Careful, almost oblique. Like he's circling something. Quiet, steady delivery. Not accusatory — just asking her to remember. Slight weight on the question.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、「貧乏人の自慢話」って言い回し気になってたな
lines.en: You seemed really bothered by that phrase — 'poor person's boasting.'
lines.style: Precise observation, delivered gently. Not accusatory. Matter-of-fact but aware she's being watched. Light tempo. Softens at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、林間学校で里山の散策したろ、桜
lines.en: You went on that forest walk at the overnight school trip, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet, almost whimsical. Gentle curiosity. Building something — not rushing. Measured pace. Like he's drawing a line she'll recognize.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣のクラスの駿と話してたな
lines.en: You were talking to Shun from the next class over.
lines.style: Soft statement, not quite a question. Observant but not accusing. Gentle tempo. The tone of someone who noticed but isn't judging.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テスト結果に「ぎょっと」してたろ、桜
lines.en: You looked shocked when you saw your test results, remember?
lines.style: Warm, almost playful. Teasing her gently. Quick snap on 'shocked.' Ends with gentle affection — he's not interrogating, just reminding. Close to her.
